pattern.pattern_name: Low Detail Outlines with User-Filled Specificity
pattern.short_summary: The system renders its output below the fidelity it could achieve, using a sparse representation and minimal accompanying text.
pattern.definition: The system renders its output below the fidelity it could achieve, using a sparse representation and minimal accompanying text. The reduction is deliberate and stated as a design goal, not a technical limit. What is withheld — detail, finish, specificity — is what the user is expected to supply.
pattern.structural_signature: A ceiling is imposed on the rendering stage: outputs are emitted in a low-detail representation (outline instead of full render, one line instead of a paragraph) uniformly across all outputs, with no affordance to raise the fidelity. The invariant is that the representation underdetermines the artifact — many finished artifacts are consistent with what is shown. Transplants to wireframes instead of mockups, outlines instead of prose, thumbnails instead of masters.

dimension.category_description: Visible rules or boundaries that restrict generation, protect artifact regions, preserve privacy, or reserve part of the task for the user.
dimension.classification_boundary: The constraint must be expressed through the interface or directly shape an observable interaction; invisible policies are excluded.

candidates.title: CreativeConnect: Supporting Reference Recombination for Graphic Design Ideation with Generative AI

evidence.quote: All system-generated recombination outputs are produced in line sketches with one-line descriptions so that users can further reinterpret by themselves (DG 4).

candidates.title: Dust Off Kindle Highlights With Quologue: Surfacing Personal Data With Generative AI for Reflective Experiences

evidence.quote: By removing the contextual anchors of the highlight for users—such as the book title, the author’s name, or the full quote, Quologue transforms e-book metadata from factual reference points in the archive into prompts for personal meaning-making.
